northcraft.source: Northcraft et al. (1998), Tables 1-2 and Experimental Materials
northcraft.strict_search_complexity_proof: All payoffs are nonnegative under the source family. The printed congruent issue has exactly one both-zero option E, and every A-D option gives both roles strictly positive points. If any party has total zero, the congruent issue must be E. Changing only that issue to A makes both parties strictly positive, so every rejected start has a one-step improving path to agreement.
northcraft.endpoint_condition: The two unprinted integrative issues retain the described strictly monotone zero-based template shape, so each role has exactly one zero-payoff option per omitted issue. This is a structural interpretation of similar payoffs and the preference-function design, not a recovered full numerical schedule.
northcraft.strict_bargaining_zone_calculation: For each party, total zero occurs at its unique own-worst option on each of six issues. The two role-specific zero-total packages are distinct because the printed opposed issues have different worst options. Exactly two of 15625 complete packages fail >0.
northcraft.conservative_bound_proof: The four printed templates fix a unique zero combination for each role. At most 25 settings of the two unknown issues can accompany it. The role-specific zero-total sets are disjoint by the printed opposed templates. Thus at most 50 complete offers fail strict positivity; this loose bound does not infer unprinted zero multiplicities.
unresolved_source_ambiguities: Nonlinear maximum 259 is visibly printed, while straightforward scaling would suggest 255. No silent typo correction is justified.
The exact two omitted option schedules and their assignment to physical issue names are not recovered.

beersma.source: Beersma (2002), Small group negotiation and team performance, Chapter 4; corresponding Beersma and De Dreu (2002) study
beersma.marginal_source: Chapter 4, printed p. 71 / PDF p. 18, coalition manipulation checks
beersma.design_source: Chapter 4, printed p. 63 / PDF p. 10: 2 symmetry x 2 decision rule x 2 social motive; random assignment of groups
beersma.social_motive_marginal_count_constraint: Each motive has at least 4 groups and at most 87 groups; exact prosocial/egoistic totals are not reported. These instruction-only conditions do not create distinct numerical payoff models.
beersma.cell_nonemptiness_evidence: Table 5, printed p. 73 / PDF p. 20, and Table 6, printed p. 78 / PDF p. 25, report finite means for all eight cells. ANOVA error df 83 with 91 groups is consistent with all eight factorial cells populated.
integer_constraints: Each of the eight symmetry x rule x motive cells has an integer count >=1.
Sum over symmetry=Symmetrical is 47; Asymmetrical is 44.
Sum over rule=Unanimity is 46; Majority is 45.
Each collapsed cell contains two nonempty motive cells, so integer 4<=x<=44.
beersma.tables_checked: Tables 4-6 provide global SDs and cell means, but no cell Ns or cell SDs. Mean/SD rounding is not converted into assumed sample sizes.

coverage: Primary > RV; one inclusive >= full check, six > source-bound full checks and 123 > point-model scenarios. Full checks use 5000 draws and required omissions; the 123 scenarios are point checks only.

primary_calculation.beersma_allocation_assumption: Uniform average over source-feasible integer x4..44; meanx24; assumed weights [24,23,22,22]/91, not observed joint counts
primary_calculation.northcraft: Explicit zero-profile endpoint structural inference in the source certificates
